note: Recorded control-2 inputs from two native x86_64 runs of the Percona proof, un-sabotaged, same candidate digest and runner image. Latencies are in seconds. 'worst' is each tenant's worst statement over the whole run, 'baseline' its worst statement before the first dump. The quiet run passed on main; the noisy run was a slow shared runner whose own commit latency alone broke the 100 ms limit.
